sources.evidence: BIL owns its XposedModule entry and ModernHookRuntime wiring; this is not a public MeguvizHook consumer API.
Member lookup and negative caching remain BIL baseline behavior through KavaMemberLookup.
SnapshotHookConfigSource copies configuration to an immutable map at installation time.
API 102 setId is isolated from the API 101 compatibility path.
ModernMemberHookCreator provides before/after/replace; argOrNull avoids array copying; constant replacement exits before argument inspection; default exception policy is PROTECT_HOST.

consumer_boundary.a1_facade_visibility: internal to BIL; not imported or copied into MeguvizHook
consumer_boundary.future_a1_owner: a BIL-owned read-only adapter/cell is required for execution; no BIL development task is created here
consumer_boundary.initial_backend: libxposed API 102; API 101 requires a separate cell
consumer_boundary.exception_equivalence: BIL PROTECT_HOST differs from MeguvizHook PROPAGATE; only non-throwing B01/B02 are equivalent performance controls

workloads.semantic_input: static no-argument target returning 42L; callbacks perform no logging, reflection, configuration or business work
workloads.A0_direct_backend: direct libxposed Hooker with empty before/after and exactly one proceed; no argument-array access
workloads.A1_bil_existing_facade: ModernMemberHookCreator.before and after with empty bodies; no args or argOrNull access
workloads.A2_meguvizhook: HookSpec with ParameterAccess.NO_ARGS and empty before/after callbacks
workloads.correctness: return 42L; original executes exactly once; no early outcome; no callback failure
workloads.comparison: callback CPU only; A2-A1 is facade cost, A1-A0 is existing BIL facade cost

workloads.semantic_input: static add(int,int) target with arguments 3 and 4 returning 7; callbacks only read the two slots
workloads.A0_direct_backend: direct libxposed Hooker reads chain.args[0] and chain.args[1], then proceeds once unchanged
workloads.A1_bil_existing_facade: ModernHookParam.argOrNull(0) and argOrNull(1), then one unchanged proceed; no args array copy
workloads.A2_meguvizhook: HookSpec with ParameterAccess.READ_ARGS reads getArgument(0) and getArgument(1), then one unchanged original call
workloads.correctness: return 7; original executes exactly once with arguments 3 and 4; no result or argument mutation
workloads.comparison: callback CPU only; BIL lazy/no-copy behavior is baseline and must not be counted as a new SDK optimization

excluded_from_equivalence.B03_to_B10: retain existing A0/A2 controls; no A1 equivalence is inferred from B01/B02
excluded_from_equivalence.constant_replacement: BIL-specific baseline fast path; not silently added to A2
excluded_from_equivalence.configuration_snapshots: installation-time behavior; excluded from callback CPU and not counted as an A2 feature
excluded_from_equivalence.business_hooks: host-specific behavior, reflection caches and logging are outside the fixed micro-workloads
excluded_from_equivalence.throwing_paths: PROTECT_HOST and PROPAGATE are not equivalent; no shared performance claim

gate.forbidden_claim: performance improvement, device qualification or frozen thresholds
